clips.send: These vessels are open at the top and connected at the bottom. With the same liquid and equal air pressure above both surfaces, the liquid settles at the same height in both arms, even when the widths differ.

clips.send: A liquid at rest exerts pressure. In the same liquid, deeper means higher pressure, and points at the same depth have equal pressure. At any one point, pressure is the same in every direction. Measure depth h vertically down from the surface.

clips.send: On a typical lifting wing, the air often moves faster above the wing, where the pressure is lower. The pressure difference produces lift, and the wing turns the airflow downward overall. Air passing above and below can reach the back edge at different times.

clips.send: Water pushes on the probe’s flexible membrane and raises the air pressure in the hose. The water falls on the connected side and rises on the open side. Read the vertical difference ΔH. In this ideal model, both liquids are water, so ΔH equals the probe depth.

clips.send: Air has weight and exerts pressure. Torricelli inverted a mercury-filled tube with a sealed end into a mercury reservoir. The top of the tube is nearly a vacuum, and air pressure supports the mercury column above the reservoir surface.

clips.send: Water boils when its vapor pressure matches the surrounding pressure. Lower air pressure lowers the boiling point. A pressure cooker raises the pressure and the boiling point.

clips.send: Follow the same path through a steady flow at the same height. Where the air moves faster, its static pressure is lower, as long as friction and density changes are small. A pressure gauge connected to the pipe wall reads the static pressure there.

clips.send: Average pressure (压强, yāqiáng) is perpendicular force F divided by contact area S. The force acts at right angles to the surface. Keep the force fixed and compare the marks made by the three faces.

clips.send: 典型机翼产生升力时，上方气流往往较快，静压较低。机翼上下的压强差产生向上的升力，机翼也使气流总体向下偏转。上下两路空气到达机翼后缘的时间可以不同。

clips.send: 空气有重力，大气对物体产生压强。托里拆利把装满水银、一端封闭的玻璃管倒立在水银槽中。管顶近似真空，大气压支撑着管内外液面之间的水银柱。
